subject: english
chapter_title: A Homage to Our Brave Soldiers

concepts.title: The National War Memorial and Its Chakras
concepts.section: A Homage to Our Brave Soldiers, Let us read I
concepts.definition: The letter describes the National War Memorial near India Gate, built in 2019, with the eternal Amar Jawan Jyoti under a central obelisk and four circles: Amar, Veerta, Tyag and Raksha Chakra, each honouring one aspect of the soldiers' gift.
concepts.formula: memorial = obelisk + eternal flame + four chakras
concepts.key_idea: The memorial's design maps the soldiers' gifts, immortality, bravery, sacrifice and protection, onto four concentric circles.
concepts.textbook_ref: gepr105.txt, A Homage to Our Brave Soldiers, Let us read I
question_patterns: describe the four chakras of the national war memorial
what does the amar jawan jyoti symbolise
which circle of the memorial is called the circle of sacrifice
what is etched on the tablets of the tyag chakra walls
why does the raksha chakra have a row of trees
when was the national war memorial built and by whom was it inaugurated

solution_steps.explain: Note where the memorial stands, when it was built and what it honours.
Name each chakra and the part of the soldiers' spirit it stands for.
Say why an ever-burning flame is the right tribute to fallen soldiers.

concepts.title: Gallantry Awards and the Param Vir Chakra
concepts.section: A Homage to Our Brave Soldiers, Let us read I
concepts.definition: The letter lists India's gallantry medals, from the Param Vir Chakra, the highest wartime award, to the Maha Vir, Kirti, Vir and Shaurya Chakras, and recalls heroes from Major Somnath Sharma, the first PVC, to the Kargil war.
concepts.key_idea: Medals keep memory alive: each award carries a citation that retells one act of courage for the nation.
concepts.textbook_ref: gepr105.txt, A Homage to Our Brave Soldiers, Let us read I
question_patterns: which is india's highest wartime gallantry award
who was the first recipient of the param vir chakra
name the heroes awarded the param vir chakra after the 1971 war
what does a citation of a gallantry award contain
why were the maha vir chakra and other awards instituted
which wars are remembered on the tablets of the memorial

solution_steps.explain: Rank the medals from highest wartime honour downwards as the letter lists them.
Match each named soldier with his war and award.
Retell a single citation in plain words to show what gallantry means.

concepts.title: Lance Naik Albert Ekka: A Citation of Courage
concepts.section: A Homage to Our Brave Soldiers, citation
concepts.definition: The citation tells how Lance Naik Albert Ekka charged an enemy bunker, silenced a machine gun though wounded, and cleared bunker after bunker in the 1971 war until the objective fell and he died of his injuries.
concepts.key_idea: Reading a citation closely shows supreme sacrifice as a series of choices, each made without thought of self.
concepts.textbook_ref: gepr105.txt, A Homage to Our Brave Soldiers, citation
question_patterns: what did lance naik albert ekka do at gangasagar
why was albert ekka awarded the param vir chakra
what does the citation say about his disregard to personal safety
how did ekka silence the enemy machine gun in the building
what happened to albert ekka after the capture of the objective
which qualities of the soldier does the citation highlight

solution_steps.explain: Note the place, year and enemy position described in the citation.
List each brave action, from the first charge to the last bunker.
State what the supreme sacrifice of the soldier teaches the reader.

concepts.title: Letter Format: Sharing an Experience
concepts.section: A Homage to Our Brave Soldiers, Let us read
concepts.definition: The chapter is a friendly letter: address and date at the top, a warm opening, the visit told in order, feelings woven through facts, and a closing greeting; Soumya writes to Ananda to share her trip to the memorial.
concepts.key_idea: A letter's personal voice, questions, little jokes about food, carries big public feelings like gratitude and pride.
concepts.textbook_ref: gepr105.txt, A Homage to Our Brave Soldiers, Let us read
question_patterns: who has written the letter and to whom
which parts of a friendly letter can you identify in the chapter
why does soumya write such a long letter to ananda
how does the writer describe her feelings at the memorial
what does soumya plan to present in the school assembly
how does the letter form make the homage feel personal

solution_steps.explain: Mark the date, greeting, body and farewell of the letter.
Note how the visit moves from arrival to each chakra to the return home.
Point out lines where personal feeling is mixed with information.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Why does the Amar Jawan Jyoti burn day and night at the memorial?

solution_template.explain: Amar Jawan means immortal soldier, so the flame stands for spirits that never die.
The ever-burning flame assures fallen heroes that the nation will never forget their sacrifice.

worked_examples.question_pattern: How does Soumya open her letter and set up the visit?

solution_template.explain: She asks after Ananda's family and recalls their talk on war and peace.
She invites her friend to guess the monument, pulling the reader into the story before naming the memorial.
